An AI-driven hybrid deep learning framework for advanced cost optimization. Features specialized TabNet models (optimized/final variants), integrated metaheuristic optimization via Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO), robust repo analysis tools, automated graph generation, and a complete frontend interface.

GitLab Fork Repository Analyzer is a tool that analyzes public GitLab repositories to identify active forks, compare commit activity, inspect license metadata, and present repository health insights. It uses the GitLab REST API, concurrent analysis, and lightweight caching to turn scattered repository metadata into an actionable engineering view.

A java tool that would take multiple reports from various systems and combine them into a single report to provide a high level view of what was happening in all the systems at a given point in time. It would also find points of failures in the systems and try to find the reason for those failures base upon the snapshot of other systems at that point of time. (Specific to Performance Testing)
